result:
Looking at the qlang documentation and the input data, I'll work through each task systematically.

Let me trace through the key concepts:
- `|` pipes data through steps
- `*` maps over array/map elements
- `filter` uses a quote with a boolean test
- `at` reads softly (returns null if missing)
- `coalesce` provides a default for null
- Names are bound with `:name value`

M1: Filter active users with non-null email, lowercase emails, sort
```
filter ~(if (/active | eq true) (at /email | ne null) false) | * (/email | lower) | sort
```

M2: Average age, numeric only, rounded to 1 decimal
```
* (at /profile | at /age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | [(reduce 0 ~(add)) (count)] | / /0 | div /1 | round 1
```

M3: Count users per country, uppercase keys
```
* (at /profile | at /country | if (ne null) (upper) null) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy * count
```

M4: Open issues with "bug" label (case-insensitive), sorted by priority desc then id asc, top 2
```
filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | sort ~([(/priority | mul -1) /id]) | take 2 | * /id
```

M5: Count open/shipped issues per assignee (null → "unassigned")
```
* (at /assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
```

M6: All labels, lowercase, deduplicated, sorted
```
* /labels | flat | * (lower) | distinct | sort
```

M7: Dependencies, strip leading ^ or ~, sort by name
```
:deps /dependencies | /deps | keys | * {:name / :version (/deps | at / | if (take 1 | eq "^") (drop 1) (if (take 1 | eq "~") (drop 1) /))} | sort ~/name
```

M8: Sum qty*price for paid/shipped orders, rounded to 2 decimals
```
filter ~(if (/status | eq "paid") true (/status | eq "shipped")) | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2
```

M9: Top 2 customers by total spend (non-cancelled), sort desc by total then asc by customer
```
filter ~(if (/status | eq "cancelled") false true) | groupBy ~/customer | * (* /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2) | :map / | keys | * {:customer / :total (/map | at /)} | sort ~([(/total | mul -1) /customer]) | take 2
```

M10: Services with tls.enabled true, "host:port" format, sorted by service name
```
:services /services | /services | keys | filter ~(services | at / | at /tls | at /enabled | eq true) | sort | * ((:svc (services | at /) | [(/svc | /host) ((/svc | at /port | coalesce 80) | print)] | join ":"))
```

M11: ERROR lines per service
```
lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy * count
```

M12: WARN or ERROR lines with "timeout" in message, distinct services
```
lines | filter ~((:parts (split " ") | (if (/parts | /1 | eq "WARN") true (/parts | /1 | eq "ERROR")) | if / ((/parts | drop 3 | join " ") | lower | contains "timeout") false)) | * (split " " | /2) | distinct | sort
```

M13: Average salary per dept, omit depts with no data, round to nearest integer
```
lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | * {:dept /1 :salary (/2 | if (ne "") (parseJson) null)} | filter ~(/salary | ne null) | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | [(sum) (count)] | / /0 | div /1 | round 0)
```

M14: Top 3 words by count from given text
```
"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " | * (split ".") | flat | * (split ",") | flat | * (split ";") | flat | * (lower) | filter ~(ne "") | groupBy * count | :map / | keys | * ({:word (keyword) :count (/map | at /)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
```
